title: Exoto 1:18 Tyrrell P34 Six Wheeler Jody Scheckter #3 1976 Japan GP GPC97044
description:
Exoto 1:18 scale diecast, Grand Prix Classics series (GPC97044): the 1976 Tyrrell Ford P34 six-wheeler, Jody Scheckter #3, Elf/Team Tyrrell livery as run at the 1976 Japanese Grand Prix at Fuji - note the Japanese script under the elf logo on the nose. Highly detailed model with the Ford Cosworth DFV engine, rear suspension, cockpit with belts and steering wheel, and all six Goodyear-lettered wheels. Chrome underside marked (c)1997 Exoto Inc. with serial number A1269.

Model only - no box or certificate. About 8 1/2 inches long.

Condition: Pre-owned display model. Paint and decals are bright and clean, wings, tires and engine detail intact. The chrome underside pan shows light scuffs and scratches (see photos). No driver figure. Please review all photos - they are of the actual model you will receive.
condition_description: Display model, no box or certificate. Paint and decals clean; light scuffs and scratches on the chrome underside pan. No driver figure.
